title: Cheflæge til Plastik- og Brystkirurgi, Aarhus Universitetshospital
description:
Høje faglige ambitioner. Samarbejde på tværs. Sammen om patienterne.

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi på Aarhus Universitetshospital er en højt specialiseret afdeling med stærke faglige miljøer, komplekse patientforløb og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling. Afdelingen spiller en vigtig rolle i en lang række patientforløb på tværs af AUH og har mange samarbejdsflader til andre specialer og fagligheder.

Afdelingen har gennem de senere år været igennem forandringer og er i gang med en ambitiøs kapacitets- og kompetenceopbygning. Vi søger nu både en ny cheflæge og chefsygeplejerske, som sammen får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af afdelingen. De to rekrutteringer gennemføres parallelt, og som ny cheflæge får du derfor mulighed for sammen med din kommende ledelsesmakker at sætte retning for den næste fase.

Opgaven er at bygge videre på afdelingens stærke faglighed og gode samarbejde og samtidig skabe tydelige rammer for den fortsatte udvikling. Sammen med chefsygeplejersken skal du stå i spidsen for en afdeling, hvor høj faglig kvalitet, bæredygtig drift, forskning, uddannelse og udvikling går hånd i hånd – og hvor et respektfuldt og åbent samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og patientforløb er en central ambition.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som cheflæge har du sammen med chefsygeplejersken ansvar for afdelingens samlede drift og udvikling. Du får samtidig et særligt ansvar for den lægefaglige retning og for at skabe rammerne for fortsat høj kvalitet, faglig udvikling og attraktive lægefaglige miljøer.

En væsentlig del af opgaven bliver at positionere og udvikle afdelingens specialer i en tid, hvor rammerne for sundhedsvæsenet er under forandring. Du skal være med til at omsætte specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen til konkrete faglige og organisatoriske prioriteringer og sikre, at afdelingen er en aktiv medspiller i udviklingen af sammenhængende patientforløb på tværs af hospitaler, sektorer og geografi.

Som cheflæge har du særligt fokus på at:

  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem drift, kvalitet, uddannelse, forskning og innovation.
  • Sætte retning for den lægefaglige udvikling og sikre høj kvalitet i afdelingens patientforløb.
  • Arbejde strategisk med specialeplanen og sikre fortsat udvikling og positionering af afdelingens specialiserede funktioner.
  • Omsætte sundhedsreformen til relevante faglige og organisatoriske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet på tværs af AUH, regionen og det øvrige sundhedsvæsen.
  • Skabe tydelige rammer for prioritering, ansvar og beslutninger i den lægefaglige organisation.
  • Udvikle attraktive faglige miljøer, hvor specialister og øvrige medarbejdere har mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle deres kompetencer og bidrage til afdelingens udvikling.
  • Bidrage til et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv og et godt arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, trivsel og psykologisk tryghed.
  • Bidrage til bæredygtig drift og balancerede prioriteringer i en hverdag med høje faglige ambitioner og begrænsede ressourcer.

Afdelingen arbejder med en relativt flad struktur, hvor ansvar delegeres, og medarbejdere og ledere forventes at bidrage aktivt til løsningen af kerneopgaven. Som cheflæge skal du derfor kunne sætte en tydelig retning uden at have behov for at stå med alle beslutninger selv. Du skal skabe rammer for involvering og fagligt råderum og samtidig være tydelig, når der er behov for prioritering og beslutning.

Sammen med chefsygeplejersken får du en central rolle i at videreudvikle afdelingens ledelseskapacitet. Jeres samarbejde bygger på fælles ansvar for helheden og på, at forskellige faglige og ledelsesmæssige perspektiver skal styrke de beslutninger, der træffes.

Kvalifikationer

Du er speciallæge i plastikkirurgi eller brystkirurgi og har en stærk faglig profil og forståelse for arbejdet i en højt specialiseret kirurgisk afdeling.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med personaleledelse og økonomistyring. Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med organisationsudvikling og forandringsledelse og har erfaring med at skabe udvikling i en kompleks organisation med mange fagligheder og samarbejdsrelationer.

Du har blik for de større sammenhænge i sundhedsvæsenet og kan omsætte strategiske og politiske rammer til meningsfulde prioriteringer i den kliniske hverdag. Du kan navigere i et sundhedsvæsen under forandring og bidrage aktivt til afdelingens position og udvikling i relation til blandt andet specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen.

Som leder er du:

  • Lyttende, nysgerrig og relationelt stærk.
  • I stand til at skabe følgeskab gennem tillid, faglig respekt og inddragelse.
  • Tydelig, konsistent og transparent i din ledelse.
  • Optaget af læring og ser fejl som en del af udviklingen.
  • Motiveret for at bygge videre på det, der allerede fungerer godt.

Du formår at kombinere en stærk lægefaglig identitet med blik for afdelingens samlede opgave. Du kan engagere dig i den faglige udvikling og samtidig træde tydeligt ind i de prioriteringer og ledelsesbeslutninger, der følger med ansvaret for en stor og kompleks afdeling.

En formel lederuddannelse er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du ikke allerede en relevant lederuddannelse, tilrettelægger vi sammen et relevant udviklingsforløb med udgangspunkt i din erfaring, dine udviklingsområder og afdelingens behov.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central ledelsesrolle i en fagligt stærk og højt specialiseret afdeling med engagerede medarbejdere og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge både afdelingens lægefaglige udvikling og den bredere udvikling på Aarhus Universitetshospital. Du bliver en del af et miljø med tæt samarbejde på tværs af specialer og faggrupper og med aktive nationale og internationale forsknings- og uddannelsesrelationer.

Som leder på AUH får du adgang til ledelsesudvikling, sparring og faglige netværk. Når du starter som afdelingsleder på AUH, får du et tilpasset onboardingforløb med udgangspunkt i dine erfaringer, dine behov og den ledelsesopgave, du træder ind i.

Om Plastik- og Brystkirurgi og AUH

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi er en højt specialiseret afdeling med ca. 140 medarbejdere og en vigtig rolle i komplekse patientforløb på tværs af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Afdelingens plastikkirurgiske og rekonstruktive kompetencer indgår blandt andet i patientforløb inden for kræftbehandling, traumatologi og medfødte misdannelser, og afdelingen har derfor mange samarbejdsflader på tværs af hospitalets specialer.

Afdelingen varetager plastikkirurgiske og brystkirurgiske patientforløb primært for patienter fra Region Midtjylland og har et aktivt forsknings- og uddannelsesmiljø med nationale og internationale samarbejdspartnere. I 2025 behandlede afdelingen ca. 9.200 unikke patienter og gennemførte knap 7.600 operationer.

Hos os møder du ledere og medarbejdere, der er dedikerede til opgaven og drevet af at sikre høj kvalitet i komplekse kirurgiske patientforløb. Vi har høje faglige ambitioner og ønsker fortsat at udvikle vores faglighed og vores samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, specialer og patientforløb.

Aarhus Universitetshospital er et internationalt anerkendt og højt specialiseret universitetshospital med stærke faglige miljøer og et tæt samarbejde med Aarhus Universitet og internationale partnere. Mere end 12.000 medarbejdere arbejder hver dag sammen om at udvikle og levere sundhedsvæsen af høj kvalitet.

Ansættelsesvilkår, ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Som afdelingsleder på AUH refererer du til sundheds- og hospitalsledelsen og indgår i hospitalets samlede ledelsesstruktur. Du kan læse mere om dit formelle ansvar, opgaver og beføjelser i AUH's ledelsesmodel og stillingsbeskrivelsen for ledere i Region Midtjylland.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag stiles til hospitalsledelsen på AUH. Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende autorisation og børneattest.

Forud for ansættelse gennemføres en skriftlig lægefaglig bedømmelse af ansøgernes kompetencer inden for de syv lægeroller.

Tiltrædelse er [1/12]. Ansøgningsfristen er [21/9].

Første samtalerunde afholdes [19/10], og anden samtalerunde afholdes [26/10]. Mellem første og anden samtalerunde gennemføres assessment som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål eller er du nysgerrig på ledelsesopgaven, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Thomas Balle Kristensen Sundheds-og Hospitalsdirektør, tlf. +4530387193/tbk@auh.rm.dk eller Charlotte Rosenkrantz Josefsen tlf.+45 29177035/chajos@rm.dk  for en uformel samtale.

Hvis du er nysgerrig på hverdagen og ledelsesopgaven i afdelingen, tager konstitueret cheflæge Gorm von Oettingen tlf.+4529724089/ dr.gorm@aarhus.rm.dk også gerne en snak med dig.

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: 3-year Postdoctoral Position in Sustainable Pig Nutrition and Methane Mitigation
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a 3-year postdoctoral position in pig nutrition with focus on climate and environmental mitigation strategies. The position is available from 1 November 2026 or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Monogastric Nutrition.

The position
We seek a highly qualified candidate with a strong background in animal science, veterinary science, or biology. The overall aim of the research is to evaluate feedstuffs and develop nutritional strategies and climate mitigation tools aimed at reducing enteric methane emissions from pigs. In addition, the research aims at generating fundamental knowledge on baseline methane production across different physiological stages of pigs, including growing pigs, gestating sows, lactating sows, and organically raised pigs.

The successful candidate will:
  • Participate in ongoing research projects and contribute to the development of new projects focused on climate mitigation strategies for pig production.
  • Quantify and document enteric methane emissions, nutrient digestion and retention from gestating and lactating sows and growing pigs.
  • Evaluate the nutritional value of fermented rapeseed meal and seaweed products and assess their effects on nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) excretion, methane emissions, and pig health.
  • Evaluate enteric methane emissions associated with feedstuffs, feed additives, and roughages used in organic pig production.
  • Participate in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contribute to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.

Qualifications for the postdoctoral position
  • Academic qualifications at PhD level in animal or veterinary sciences.
  • Research experience in pig nutrition.
  • Experience in conducting different types of animal experiments.
  • Skills in the analysis of experimental data and the scientific communication of research results.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, an effort to learn to read, write, and speak Danish is a requirement.

Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Jan Værum Nørgaard, phone: +4550718795, email: janvnoergaard@anivet.au.dk

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor, master and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Vil du også være på den grønne gren?
description:
Er du uddannet pædagog, kan levere varmt nærvær i børnehøjde og være fagligt reflekterende i dit arbejde, er det dig vi leder efter

Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  18.09.2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Professor/ Associate Professor in Public Health
description:
Om Aarhus UniversitetAarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.000 studerende og 8.700 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,3 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

The Department of Public Health at the Faculty of Health Sciences, Aarhus University, invites applications for a position at the level of full Professor or Associate Professor. The expected start date is January 1st 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

The candidate will contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities within innovation and collaboration by building innovation capacity and developing collaboration with external parties. The candidate will be part of an innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem at Aarhus University (AU). AU is currently strengthening its strategic efforts within innovation and entrepreneurship. This effort is a direct extension of AU’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship constitute a central strategic focus area. With the aim of expanding AU’s capacity to link research and innovation, the university leadership has decided to create a number of new research and innovation positions across the university. The newly created positions are intended to help integrate an innovation mindset into the university culture, while at the same time producing concrete, visible impact and societal benefit.

About the Department
The Department of Public Health is research-intensive and has a strong international and collaborative orientation. Our research spans theoretical, basic, and applied sciences, with the goal of generating impactful knowledge and improving population health. We are built on a foundation of academic excellence, and we are committed to conducting rigorous, innovative, high-quality teaching. The department is responsible for teaching at public health science, sports science, nursing science, health science, and for a significant part of teaching in the medicine program.

We are firmly rooted in our academic disciplines and actively foster interdisciplinary collaboration to drive innovation and excellence in both research and teaching. We are committed to fostering a healthy and inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, open communication, and an informal tone. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
The successful candidate will strengthen the department’s research, innovation and research-based teaching within health services research and contribute to the academic development at Aarhus University and to the university’s profile both nationally and internationally.

Your main tasks are expected to include:

* Actively contribute to the faculty community and support the faculty´s ambitions for innovation and collaboration.

* Lead your own innovation projects and facilitate the translation of research findings into practical solutions.

* Identify innovation potential within the research environments.

* Expanding your research activities by securing external funding and thus contributing to the department’s strategic goals.

* Increase local awareness and visibility of innovation initiatives.

* Implement initiatives decided by the faculty leadership and the dean’s office.

* Teaching and supervising students within innovation

* Supervising PhD students

* Participating in academic assessment and committee work at Aarhus University.

* Disseminating your research to both academic and broader audiences

You will report to the Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard.

Your competences

You have established yourself as a prominent researcher within your scientific field and can document research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have a network of international partners, experience in attracting significant research funding from national and international funding bodies, and a potential of becoming a skilled research leader. In the hiring process, we place particular emphasis on professional experience gained through employment or extended research stays at internationally recognized universities or research institutions outside the candidate’s primary place of employment.

We particularly value documented experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Public Health services research

* Artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced analytics in healthcare

* Health economic, public health policy, and leadership in healthcare organizations

* Digital transformation and applied data driven decision making in public health organizations

* Cross-sectoral collaboration across health organizations

* A strong record of securing external funding for interdisciplinary and collaborative research projects

The successful candidate has a strong international network and demonstrated experience in interdisciplinary collaboration across health services research, digital health and leadership.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications. Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard tel.: (+45) 4022 7649. Your place of work will be the Department of Public Health, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Terms of employment - professor


  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.


  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor


  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.


  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment


  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.


  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).


  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.


  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.


  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.



International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Go-to-Market Responsible
description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar office software

  • Able to use inventory, purchasing, or restaurant management software

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to identify operational problems through reports and data

  • Experience creating and implementing SOPs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Central kitchen or food production experience

  • New restaurant opening experience

  • Menu development and product standardisation experience

  • Experience working in a multi-brand restaurant group

  • Knowledge of Danish food safety and restaurant regulations

  • Previous restaurant industry experience in Denmark

We Offer

  • A key management position in a growing Asian restaurant group in Copenhagen

  • Responsibility across multiple brands and restaurant locations

  • Significant operational responsibility and development opportunities

  • Opportunity to participate in new restaurant openings, product development, and central kitchen development

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Community Lead
description:
Do you have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture and a natural instinct for bringing people together?

ONLY BRAND HOUSE is looking for a Community Lead to shape, grow and strengthen the communities around our brand.

From intimate community gatherings and creative partnerships to larger-scale events and brand activations, this role will create experiences that bring ONLY BRAND HOUSE into the real world and give people meaningful reasons to engage with and participate in the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
As our Community Lead, you will develop meaningful relationships between ONLY BRAND HOUSE and the people, places and cultural communities surrounding our brand.
You will work across multiple European markets, building an international network of creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors, ambassadors and brand advocates who authentically connect with ONLY BRAND HOUSE. A particular focus will be on developing our community presence within French-speaking markets.

Working closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Communications and our local markets, you will turn cultural insights and relationships into relevant experiences, partnerships and activations. Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute ONLY's community strategy across key markets

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors and brand advocates

  • Identify emerging communities, people and cultural movements relevant to ONLY

  • Develop and execute events, gatherings, launches, pop-ups and cultural activations from concept to delivery

  • Build ONLY's community presence within French-speaking markets

  • Develop creative partnerships with relevant talent, venues, organisations and complementary brands

  • Collaborate with Social and Communications on talent, seeding and organic brand relationships

  • Track community growth, engagement and impact while bringing relevant cultural insights back into the wider Brand team

WHY JOIN ONLY BRAND HOUSE?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how ONLY BRAND HOUSE builds communities and shows up in culture across international markets. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Shape and develop ONLY’s international community approach

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers and cultural connectors

  • Turn ideas and cultural opportunities into real-world experiences and activations

  • Work across markets and bring local insights and perspectives into the brand

  • Join a collaborative Brand team where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged

ABOUT YOU
You are a connector by nature. You genuinely enjoy meeting people, building relationships and bringing different communities together. At the same time, you know how to turn an idea into reality and are comfortable owning events and projects from concept through to execution. We imagine that you:

  • Have 3–5 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, cultural marketing, PR or a related field

  • Have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture

  • Have experience developing and executing events, activations or community initiatives

  • Understand the difference between building a community and simply building an audience

  • Are proactive, highly organised and comfortable balancing relationship-building with execution

  • Are professionally fluent in both English and French

  • Experience working across European markets and an existing network within fashion, creative or cultural communities are both considered strong advantages.

INTERESTED?
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Head Of Creative, Joshua Mark Bredehoeft on +45 71990213. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than September 10th, 2026. We review applications continuously and reserve the right to close the position once we have found the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark

Join the Team at Ærø Hotel

Are you reliable, hardworking and looking for an opportunity to live and work in Denmark?

Ærø Hotel is currently looking for 2 motivated employees to join our housekeeping team.

The positions primarily involve housekeeping, but the housekeeping team also assists with the hotel’s dishwashing department as part of the daily operation.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a family-owned and family-operated hotel located in the maritime town of Marstal on the beautiful island of Ærø, Denmark.

The hotel has:

  • 100 hotel rooms

  • Around 35,000 overnight stays every year

  • Restaurant and Compass Bar

  • Conference and event facilities

  • Indoor swimming pool

  • Fitness room

  • An international team with employees from several European countries

Ærø Hotel is Denmark’s only adults-only hotel, welcoming guests aged 18 years and above.

English is the primary working language at the hotel, so it is not necessary to speak Danish.

Your Responsibilities

Your daily responsibilities will include:

  1. Cleaning and preparing guest rooms

  2. Cleaning bathrooms

  3. Changing bed linen and towels

  4. Making beds according to hotel standards

  5. Restocking guest amenities and supplies

  6. Cleaning corridors and other public areas

  7. Ensuring that all rooms are clean, tidy and ready for arriving guests

  8. Following the hotel’s cleaning procedures and quality standards

  9. Assisting in the hotel’s dishwashing department

  10. Washing dishes, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

  11. Keeping the dishwashing area clean and organised

  12. Working closely with the rest of the housekeeping team to ensure an efficient daily operation

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are reliable, responsible and hardworking

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Work well as part of a team

  • Are able to work independently

  • Are comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high standard

  • Are flexible regarding working hours, including weekends

  • Preferably have previous experience from hotels, housekeeping or professional cleaning

Previous housekeeping experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to work are equally important.

What We Offer

  • Full-time employment

  • 2 available positions

  • Start as soon as possible

  • Hourly salary of DKK 130 before tax

  • 12.5% Danish holiday pay in addition to the hourly salary

  • Stable employment

  • Friendly and international colleagues

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Staff accommodation available

  • The opportunity to live and work on the beautiful island of Ærø

Staff Accommodation

Staff accommodation is available approximately 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

At present, each employee has a private bedroom, while kitchen and bathroom facilities are shared with other employees.

Rent is DKK 750 per person per week, including:

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and a small private kitchen, providing significantly improved and more independent living facilities for our employees.

title: We Are Hiring – Experienced Chef
description:
EU/EEA citizenship or valid right to work in Denmark required

Ærø Hotel is looking for an experienced, skilled and reliable Chef to join our international kitchen team.

We are located on the beautiful Danish island of Ærø, in the maritime town of Marstal. We are looking for an experienced chef who enjoys working in a structured professional kitchen, preparing good-quality food for a large number of hotel guests.

We have 1 position available.

About the position

You will become part of our evening kitchen team, which consists of five chefs working closely together.

Ærø Hotel does not operate an à la carte restaurant.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/denmark-corporate-pay.html
