title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;

title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Reporting to the Head of HR Switzerland, you will provide HR Business Partner support to the Technology (R&D) and Service Divisions, as well as selected Corporate Functions including HR, Marketing & Communications and Legal, covering an employee population of around 260. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Attractive compensation & benefits.

Modern office, smart working.

Flexible working models.

Canteen.

Employee Assistance Program.

Global parental leave program.

title: SURFINSTRUKTÖR - PORTUGAL 17 juni - 12 augusti ev. till 3 november
description:
Vi ser gärna att du har följande kvalifikationer:
- Du är en skicklig surfare och pedagog
- Du kan instruera surfing med teknisk expertis på ett för gästen lättförståeligt sätt
- Tidigare erfarenhet av surfinstruktörsarbete är meriterande
- Positiv och älskar att surfa
- Surfinstruktörscertifikat.
- Certifierad från genomförd surflivräddningskurs.
- Körkort är meriterande.
- God verbal förmåga.
- Välorganiserad, ansvarstagande och positiv personlighet.
- Vi uppmanar både tjejer och killar att ansöka.
Som surfinstruktör hos Magnus & friends så har du ett av världens roligaste jobb - att se till att svenska vuxna och barn får dela glädjen med vågsurfing, avkopplingen och den härliga surfkulturens magi.

Är du duktig på att kommunicera och glädjs åt att utbilda andra?
Vill du arbeta på en av Europas vackraste platser som har bland världens bästa surfing?
Vill du vara en viktig del i vårt team som varje dag jobbar för att vara bäst i världen på det vi gör, dvs arrangera fantastiska surfupplevelser för svenska vuxna och barn?

Huvudsakliga uppgifter:
- Med professionalism, engagemang och entusiasm instruera surfing.
- Hålla ordning på campets surfutrustning, inventera och beställa nytt vid behov.
- Leda och inspirera övriga surfinstruktörer.
- Ha roligt!
- Se till att våra gäster stormtrivs och har en fantastisk vecka.
- Surfa och njuta av sommaren, människorna och surfkulturen i Portugal!

Om dig:
Vi ser gärna att du har följande kvalifikationer:
- Surfinstruktörscertifikat.
- Certifierad från genomförd surflivräddningskurs.
- Körkort är meriterande.
- God verbal förmåga.
- Välorganiserad, ansvarstagande och positiv personlighet.
- Vi uppmanar både tjejer och killar att ansöka.

Förutom fantastiska minnen och en oförglömlig sommar får du för ditt arbete och engagemang följande lön, ersättning och förmåner:
- Boende.
- Frukost samt råvaror till att laga lunch och middag tillsammans med de andra i teamet.
- Yoga 2 ggr/vecka.
- Fri tillgång till surfutrustning.
- Flygbiljetter Sverige – Portugal.
- Transfer Lissabon flygplats – Surfcampet i Baleal, Portugal.
- Viss månadslön utöver övriga förmåner

Låter det här som något som passar dig? Då vill vi att du skickar ett per personligt brev och CV till surfa@magnusandfriends.se
Magnus & friends är ett surfreseföretag som arrangerar surfpaketresor för svenska vuxna och barn till Portugal. Med fokus på hög kvalitet och små grupper ca 3-5 surfgäster per instruktör lär vi ut vågsurfing till såväl nybörjare som avancerade surfare vid vårt magiska surfcamp i Baleal, Portugal! Vi bor 5 minuters promenad från stranden i ljusa och fräscha surflägenheter och hus med tillhörande pool. Möt nya härliga människor som kanske blir dina vänner för livet! Upplev professionalism, glädje och omtanke. För barnfamiljer finns det särskilda familjepaket med aktiviteter för barn- och ungdomar och bl.a. rabatterade priser för surf och transfer.

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Senior Professional Data-Engineer (Data Engineer)
description:
who we are At adorsys, we are not just developers and analysts; we are pioneers shaping the digital future for banking and insurance sectors. For over a decade, we have crafted innovative software solutions that grant our clients a decisive edge in their business. We foster an international and agile work environment that thrives on diversity, creativity, and collaboration.
What awaits youWe are looking for experienced Data Engineers to join an international platform team responsible for the infrastructure and data management of intelligent automation services in the finance domain. The services leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning models to generate automated booking proposals from various financial data sources.

The team is currently modernizing its platform to ensure long-term scalability, stability, and performance. By 2026, all core components and data pipelines will be migrated to a modern infrastructure stack based on Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, and other state-of-the-art technologies.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and streaming solutions, ensuring high data quality, governance, and security standards.

Your profile Main Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache NiFi.
• Implement and manage data lakehouse structures based on Apache Iceberg, including schema evolution, partitioning, and time travel features.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries and data access layers with Trino, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Integrate diverse data sources (Kafka, S3, RDBMS, REST APIs, etc.) into unified pipelines.
• Ensure data quality, security, and governance across the data infrastructure.
• Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and distributed systems.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data scientists, platform engineers, business stakeholders) to deliver data-driven solutions.
• Document technical designs, concepts, and processes.

Required Skills & Experience
• Proven experience with Apache Iceberg, Apache NiFi, and Trino.
• Understanding and ability to work with Apache Spark code.
• Experience with ETL/ELT processes and integrating APIs.
• Hands-on expertise in real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.
• Strong background in large-scale data processing and distributed systems.
• Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially S3, IAM, Glue.
• Programming languages: Python, Java, or Scala.
• Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• CI/CD & DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
• Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and performance optimization techniques.

Nice to Have
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Familiarity with CI/CD automation and Infrastructure as Code.
• Practical knowledge of security configurations in data processing.

Soft Skills
• Structured and solution-oriented working style.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills within interdisciplinary teams.

The platform team develops and maintains the data infrastructure for automation services in the accounting and finance sector. These services use artificial intelligence to continuously improve booking suggestions based on historical cloud data, ensuring seamless integration into familiar workflows.
To ensure scalability and long-term stability, the platform is being migrated to a new infrastructure (Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, etc.) by 2026. This transformation secures performance, scalability, and future-proof operations.

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
In this role, you will:
Provide technical guidance to Network Provisioning specialists and support them with complex or non-standard tasks.
Review network configurations, technical instructions, and planned infrastructure changes.
Configure and provision network equipment, including Juniper, Brocade, and Extreme Networks devices.
Coordinate network installations, replacements, upgrades, and maintenance activities across multiple data centres.
Prepare clear technical assignments for on-site engineers performing physical work with network equipment.
Plan network changes, assess associated risks, and define verification and rollback procedures.
Troubleshoot provisioning-related problems and act as an escalation point for difficult technical cases.
Ensure that network changes are completed accurately and in accordance with internal standards.
Cooperate with Network Engineering and Network Operations teams on infrastructure expansion and improvement projects.
Communicate with data-centre representatives, carriers, and other service providers regarding technical and operational matters.
Maintain and improve provisioning procedures, configuration templates, technical documentation, and knowledge base materials.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive provisioning activities and reduce the risk of manual errors.
Participate in testing new network equipment, technologies, tools, and automated workflows.
Mentor team members, share technical knowledge, and support their professional development.
Contribute to workload planning and the continuous improvement of the team’s processes and service quality.

Requirements:
At least three years of professional experience in network engineering, network provisioning, telecommunications, or data-centre networking.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Good knowledge of Layer 2 technologies, including VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience planning and implementing network changes in a production environment.
Ability to diagnose network issues and make sound technical decisions.
Experience preparing technical documentation and instructions for engineers.
Ability to review the work of other specialists and provide constructive technical feedback.
Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a structured approach to work.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Written and spoken English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Practical experience with Juniper, Brocade, or Extreme Networks equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, MPLS, or data-centre fabric technologies.
Experience with network automation tools, Python, Ansible, APIs, or Git.
Familiarity with monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Experience working in the hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre industry.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
About the position

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support and develop our network infrastructure across several data centres.
You will be involved in the daily operation of the network, the investigation of connectivity issues, and the implementation of infrastructure changes. The role also includes participation in projects related to network expansion, new site connectivity, equipment deployment, and automation.

What you will do:
Operate and maintain networking equipment located in multiple data centres.
Configure network devices and monitor the availability and performance of network services.
Perform planned maintenance and take part in resolving emergency situations.
Investigate connectivity problems and other network-related incidents.
Handle requests submitted by customers and internal departments.
Work with other technical teams to implement network changes and improvements.
Participate in expanding the existing network and connecting new locations.
Assist with the selection, testing, and deployment of new networking equipment.
Contribute to the automation of routine network operations.
Create and update technical documentation.

What we are looking for:
Confident understanding of LAN and WAN fundamentals.
Good knowledge of routing technologies and dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Understanding of Layer 2 technologies, including VLANs, xSTP, and LACP.
Familiarity with network availability and redundancy mechanisms such as VRRP and link aggregation.
Ability to diagnose common network issues and perform initial troubleshooting.
English at Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for working with technical documentation and communicating with customers.
Ability to learn new technologies and process a significant amount of technical information in English.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Analytical thinking and a responsible approach to technical tasks.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer to operate and develop our network infrastructure across multiple data centres.

Responsibilities
Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment.
Troubleshoot network incidents and connectivity issues.
Perform planned maintenance and participate in emergency recovery.
Handle technical requests from customers and internal teams.
Support network expansion, new location deployments, and automation projects.
Maintain network documentation and configuration records.
Requirements
At least three years of relevant networking experience.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN technologies.
Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and network redundancy.
Ability to diagnose routing, switching, latency, and packet-loss issues.
Experience configuring network equipment through CLI.
English at Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.
Familiarity with Python, Ansible, APIs, or other automation tools.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
Main responsibilities
Handle complex customer requests through the ticketing system and live chat in Russian and English.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, refunds, credits, service charges, and account balances.
Prepare contracts and coordinate the signing process with customers and internal stakeholders.
Work with internal billing and invoicing platforms, CRM, and other operational systems.
Verify the accuracy of customer, contractual, and billing information.
Coordinate complex cases with Finance, Sales, Account Management, Support, and other departments.
Manage escalations and ensure that customers receive clear, accurate, and timely responses.
Identify recurring billing issues and suggest improvements to internal processes.
Support and mentor less experienced Billing Support Specialists.
Prepare and update instructions for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases.
Participate in testing changes to billing systems and related workflows.
Maintain a high standard of data confidentiality and accuracy.

Our expectations
At least four years of relevant experience in billing support, financial operations, accounts receivable, subscription services, or B2B customer support.
Proven experience independently handling complex billing enquiries, complaints, and escalations.
Good understanding of invoicing, payments, refunds, credit notes, account balances, and reconciliation processes.
Experience preparing, reviewing, or coordinating commercial contracts and related customer documentation.
Confident user of billing platforms, CRM systems, ticketing tools, and invoicing software.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filters, lookups, and pivot tables.
Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with financial and contractual information.
Ability to prioritize a significant workload and take ownership of cases through to their complete resolution.
Experience coordinating issues with Finance, Sales, Legal, Account Management, and technical departments.
Ability to explain complex billing matters clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.
Strong business correspondence and customer-communication skills.
Fluency in written and spoken Russian.
English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for meetings, negotiations, and professional correspondence with international customers.
Ability to mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and contribute to process improvement.
Interest in technology and the ability to understand technically complex products and services.

Would be a plus
Experience in the hosting, cloud, telecommunications, SaaS, or other subscription-based industry.
Knowledge of recurring, usage-based, and multi-currency billing models.
Experience working with payment providers, failed transactions, chargebacks, or payment disputes.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Cloud Developer (w/m/d) / Remote Spain (Cloud-Architect)
description:
Willkommen in der Welt der medizinischen Innovationen!

Bei Mesalvo geht es nicht nur um Technologie – es geht um Menschen, um Fortschritt und um die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle. Wir sind ein Unternehmen, das von der Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und modernste Technologien angetrieben wird. Unsere Grundlage ist eine tiefe medizinische Expertise, auf der wir innovative und vernetzte Softwarelösungen aufbauen. Unsere Vision ist klar: ein maßgeschneidertes, digitales Gesundheitsmanagement, das den Klinikalltag erleichtert.

Unsere Geschichte begann 2021, als wir fünf renommierte Unternehmen der Health Care IT-Branche unter einem Dach vereinten. Diese Fusion brachte nicht nur verschiedene Expertisen und Werte, sondern auch 460+ hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende an insgesamt 7 Standorten in Deutschland, Belgien und Spanien zusammen.

Klingt das nach einem Umfeld, in dem du dich entfalten möchtest? Dann werde Teil der Mesalvo-Familie und trage dazu bei, dass die Gesundheitsversorgung smarter, effizienter und menschenorientierter wird. Deine Ideen, deine Leidenschaft und dein Engagement sind hier gefragt – denn gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied! Empower Excellence in Health and Care: #empowerexcellence

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich

- Du wirst Teil unseres Softwareentwicklungsteams und arbeitest an unserer innovativen Logistiklösung für Krankenhausapotheken namens Ataxe Web
- Du gestaltest, entwickelst und optimierst moderne cloudnative Anwendungen auf Basis von Java 21 und Spring Boot
- Du konzipierst und implementierst zukunftsfähige Microservice-Architekturen
- Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme höchsten Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Datenschutz und Kosteneffizienz gerecht werden
- Du entwickelst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in bestehende Anwendungen
- Du arbeitest mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL und MongoDB, inklusive Performance-Optimierung und Sicherstellung der Datenkonsistenz
- Du setzt auf moderne Entwicklungspraktiken wie Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean Code
- Du arbeitest eng mit Frontend-Entwickler:innen sowie interdisziplinären Teams zusammen

Das bringst Du mit

- Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java 21
- Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse im Spring Framework, Spring Boot und Hibernate mit
- Du hast Erfahrung mit Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean-Code-Prinzipien
- Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Cloud-Services sammeln
- Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken, insbesondere in den Bereichen Redundanzvermeidung, Performance-Optimierung und Datenkonsistenz
- Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung verteilter Systeme mit Fokus auf moderne Cloud-Anforderungen
- Du gehst sicher mit Docker um
- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Unser Angebot als Arbeitgeber

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten: In Absprache mit deinem Team kannst du entscheiden, wann dein Tag startet.
- Remote Work: Mobiles Arbeiten, Home-Office oder bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland - du entscheidest wo du dich am wohlsten fühlst.
- Mitarbeitenden Benefits: Vom Jobrad bis zum Fitnessstudio – deine Bewegung kommt bei uns nicht zu kurz.
- Gesundheitsförderung: Freu dich auf verschiedene Angebote, die deiner Gesundheit guttun – denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.
- Events: Damit der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt, organisieren wir regelmäßig Firmenläufe, Teamevents und Weihnachtsfeiern.
- Onboarding: Sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch ein nettes und offenes Team – dieses steht dir während deines Onboarding-Prozesses jederzeit zur Verfügung.

Unser Herz schlägt für IT und wir leben Diversity

Wir haben die Charta der Vielfalt unterzeichnet und setzen uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion am Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir freuen uns über eine Vielfalt an unterschiedlichen Bewerbenden, die mit uns noch erfolgreicher werden möchten und Ihre Leidenschaft mit uns teilen.

title: Chargé(e) de Marketing & Communication (H/F)
description:

Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) de Marketing & Communication capable d'accompagner la structuration de l'image du groupe et la création de supports commerciaux clairs, professionnels et directement exploitables.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, vous participez à la mise en place et à l'amélioration des outils de communication d'AXOR Ingénierie.
Votre rôle sera de rendre les activités du groupe plus lisibles, plus professionnelles et mieux présentées auprès des clients, partenaires et équipes commerciales.
La mission porte principalement sur la création, la mise à jour et l'harmonisation des supports de communication et de présentation du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Supports marketing et communication
- Créer, mettre à jour et harmoniser les plaquettes commerciales du groupe ;
- Préparer des supports de présentation clairs pour les rendez-vous clients, partenaires et commerciaux ;
- Structurer les documents de présentation des activités : structures métalliques, ingénierie, enveloppe du bâtiment, solutions constructives ;
- Participer à l'amélioration de l'image de marque et de la cohérence visuelle des supports ;
- Mettre à jour les contenus de communication existants : site internet, présentations, documents internes et commerciaux ;
- Coordonner si besoin les échanges avec les prestataires externes : graphistes, web, imprimeurs, traducteurs.
Appui au développement commercial
- Travailler avec la Direction et les équipes commerciales pour clarifier les messages, offres et argumentaires ;
- Produire des supports simples, professionnels et utilisables rapidement sur le terrain ;
- Participer à la valorisation des projets, références, partenaires et savoir-faire du groupe ;
- Proposer des améliorations concrètes pour renforcer la visibilité et la crédibilité d'AXOR Ingénierie ;
- Accompagner progressivement la communication autour des nouvelles activités du groupe.
Profil recherché
- Expérience en marketing, communication, création de supports commerciaux ou communication d'entreprise ;
- Très bonne capacité rédactionnelle et de synthèse ;
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de présentation et de mise en page ;
- Capacité à transformer des informations techniques en supports clairs et professionnels ;
- Profil autonome, structuré, rigoureux et orienté concret ;
- Sens de l'organisation, réactivité et capacité à travailler avec plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
- Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, BTP, ingénierie ou international serait appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel apprécié ;
- Anglais apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une vraie compétence en marketing et communication, nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre rapidement les enjeux du groupe, de structurer des supports utiles et de contribuer concrètement à son développement.
