title: PhD student in Materials Physics
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

This recruitment is linked to the Impact Innovation program Swedish Metals and Minerals – an initiative of Energimyndigheten, Formas and Vinnova.

Read more: https://impactinnovation.se/en/programmes/swedish-metals-and-minerals-2/

Your work assignments

As a PhD student in this project, you will work in a world-leading group focused on application-inspired basic research in thin-film physics, particularly hard ceramic coatings.

The position involves conducting application-inspired basic research on thin film materials where the main goal is to develop new environmentally friendly surface coating processes with maintained layer quality, functionality and reduced energy consumption. The project is carried out in close collaboration with Swedish industry. Publication in scientific journals and presentations at international conferences are also expected from the successful candidate.

The project encompasses process development, plasma analysis, and the synthesis and characterization of thin films. It focuses on controlling and understanding the structure and properties of the coatings at the atomic and nanometer scales. Materials science is inherently interdisciplinary, involving close collaboration with theorists and researchers at other universities in Sweden and abroad. Our close cooperation with industry offers an additional opportunity for those who do not wish to remain in academia after completing their doctoral studies.

As a PhD student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research projects of which you are part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20 per cent of full-time.

Your qualifications

You have graduated at Master's level in physics, materials chemistry or materials science/engineering or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be in advanced courses. Alternatively, you have gained essentially corresponding knowledge in another way.

Documented experience from PVD synthesis methods, like magnetron sputtering, plasma analysis, as well as thin film characterization techniques like XRD, SEM, TEM, or XPS is beneficial.

Fluent English spoken and written is required.

Your workplace

The Thin Film Physics Division carries out research, undergraduate and postgraduate education within materials physics.

https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm/tunnf

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies. More information about the doctoral studies at each faculty is available at https://liu.se/en/research/doctoral-studies

The employment has a duration of normally four years' full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of teaching and institutional assignment. Further extensions may be granted in exceptional circumstances. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time, depending on your progress through the study plan.

Starting date by agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

More information about employment benefits at Linköping University is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than 30 September 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

title: HVDC Protection Project Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Are you passionate about power systems protection and eager to contribute to the energy transition? We are now looking for an experienced HVDC Protection Project Engineer to join our global HVDC team in Ludvika. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, implementing, and testing advanced protection systems that enable reliable and efficient transmission of electricity across the world. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, customers, and suppliers to deliver innovative HVDC solutions that support grid stability and sustainable energy development.

How You'll Make an Impact

    Lead and contribute to the specification, design, and engineering of HVDC protection systems for global projects.
    Perform protection studies including fault calculations, relay coordination, and stability analyses for HVDC converter stations and transmission systems.
    Develop and review protection philosophies, functional design specifications, logic diagrams, and test procedures.
    Configure, verify, and validate protection schemes to ensure reliable system performance and compliance with project requirements.
    Execute and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) for protection equipment and systems.
    Provide technical expertise during commissioning and post-commissioning phases, supporting successful project delivery.
    Collaborate closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and engineering disciplines to resolve technical challenges and optimize solutions.
    Drive continuous improvement initiatives, share knowledge, and mentor less experienced engineers within the organization.

Your Background

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field.
    Minimum 3 years of experience in protection engineering, preferably within HVDC, FACTS, or power transmission systems.
    Desirable understanding of HVDC technology, converter topologies (VSC and/or LCC), and associated protection principles.
    Strong knowledge of high voltage substation protection and control systems, including design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection schemes for transmission and distribution networks.
    Experience with Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) settings, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
    Proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or DIgSILENT PowerFactory.

title: Cyber Defence Expert - Incident Management & Response
description:
Solve complex problems. Decode the future.

At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

All about the role:

We are looking for a highly experienced Cyber Defense Expert to act as a Incident Management and Response subject matter expert while leading the operational maturity and effectiveness of the Security Operations Center. The role is accountable for driving strong incident lifecycle management, from detection, triage, escalation and containment through eradication, recovery, executive communication and lessons learned.

What you'll do:

Incident Management & Response Leadership

    Lead end-to-end cyber incident response activities across detection, triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery and closure.
    Act as incident commander or senior response lead for high-severity cyber incidents, ensuring clear ownership, decision-making, escalation and communication.
    Design, maintain and continuously improve incident response frameworks, playbooks, severity models, escalation paths and operating procedures.
    Coordinate technical investigations across SOC, infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, identity, network, application and third-party teams.
    Drive post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, corrective actions and measurable improvements to reduce recurrence and improve response effectiveness.

SOC Leadership & Operational Excellence

    Lead and mature SOC operations, including alert triage quality, investigation standards, escalation discipline, response workflows and service performance.
    Define and track SOC metrics, SLAs, KPIs and executive reporting related to detection, response, backlog, false positives, incident trends and operational effectiveness.
    Provide operational governance for managed SOC providers, ensuring clear accountability, quality assurance, continuous improvement and alignment with cyber defence objectives.
    Improve detection-to-response processes by strengthening SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity and cloud security workflows.
    Support analyst enablement through guidance, process clarity, knowledge sharing, playbook adoption and lessons learned from real incidents.

Detection Engineering & Automation

    Own and mature detection engineering capabilities across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity, cloud, SaaS and other critical security telemetry sources.
    Translate threat intelligence, incident lessons learned, threat hunting outcomes and MITRE ATT&CK techniques into actionable detection use cases and response logic.
    Lead the detection lifecycle, including use case design, prioritization, validation, tuning, false-positive reduction, coverage assessment and retirement of ineffective detections.
    Drive SOC automation through SOAR playbooks, automated enrichment, triage support, case management workflows, containment actions and repeatable response processes.
    Identify telemetry and logging gaps, prioritize onboarding of critical data sources and improve visibility across enterprise, cloud and identity environments.
    Partner with SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, platform owners and managed service providers to continuously improve detection coverage, response speed and operational efficiency.

Crisis Readiness, Communication & Stakeholder Coordination

    Lead cyber crisis coordination during major incidents, ensuring timely updates, clear business impact assessment and effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
    Prepare and deliver incident briefings, executive summaries, situation reports and post-incident reports for technical and non-technical audiences.
    Partner with legal, privacy, communications, risk, compliance and business continuity teams when incidents require broader enterprise coordination.
    Plan and support cyber incident exercises, tabletop simulations and readiness assessments to validate response capabilities and decision-making.
    Ensure incident response activities are aligned with internal governance, regulatory expectations and established security policies.

Qualifications:

    Minimum 8 years of experience in security operations, cyber defence, incident response or related cybersecurity roles.
    Strong hands-on experience leading or coordinating high-severity cyber incidents in complex enterprise environments.
    Deep understanding of SOC operations, alert triage, escalation management, incident handling, threat detection and response workflows.
    Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity security, cloud security monitoring and managed security service providers.
    Strong understanding of incident response frameworks and methodologies such as NIST, ISO 27035, SANS/PICERL and MITRE ATT&CK.
    Ability to communicate clearly during incidents, including concise executive updates, technical coordination and post-incident reporting.
    Proven ability to drive continuous improvement across people, process, tooling, governance and operational performance.
    Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
    Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GSEC, OSCP, CEH, Microsoft Security certifications or cloud security certifications.

Where you'll be:

This is a position based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden).

We work in a hybrid set up that gives everyone up to 20% flexibiltiy to work remotely, while boosting creatvity and collaboration through  regular office presence.

Our recruitment process may include interviews, assessments, and reference checks. As part of our recruitment process, a background check may be conducted on the final candidate(s). Any checks will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws and with the candidate's knowledge and consent.

title: Frukost/lunch värd/värdinna - Breakfast/lunch host/hostess
description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet till större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter.

Som frukostvärd/frukostvärdinna är du en viktig del av våra gästers morgon och ser till att de får en riktigt bra start på dagen. Du börjar tidigt med att förbereda och ställa i ordning frukosten inför öppning, fylla på buffén och se till att restaurangen är ren, fräsch och välkomnande. Under frukosten välkomnar du våra gäster, håller buffén välfylld, dukar av och finns till hands för frågor och önskemål.

Vi söker dig som är morgonpigg och inte har några problem med att starta dagen redan klockan 04.00, alltid med ett leende. Du har ansvarskänsla, brinner för service och tycker om att skapa en trivsam och välkomnande atmosfär. Som person är du flexibel, effektiv och har en god kommunikation med dina kollegor. Du trivs i ett högt tempo, är lösningsorienterad och ser vad som behöver göras utan att alltid behöva bli tillsagd.

Arbetet innebär ett nära samarbete med köket och övriga avdelningar, och under perioder med högt tempo hjälps vi åt där det behövs. Vi värdesätter därför prestigelöshet, laganda och viljan att bidra till en riktigt bra gästupplevelse.

Det är ett krav att du har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande, liksom tidigare erfarenhet inom restaurang, hotell eller service.

Tjänsten är en särskild visstidsanställning med start i mitten på december och slut i slutet på februari med möjlighet till förlängning.

Personalboende finns att tillgå. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten.



At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.

At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we offer breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the city’s three cultures – Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian-Finnish – and these influences are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready to combine an exciting and challenging job with the spectacular mountain landscape, magical Northern Lights and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a breakfast host, you play an important role in our guests’ mornings and make sure they get a great start to their day. You start early by preparing and setting up the breakfast before opening, keeping the buffet stocked and making sure the restaurant is clean, fresh and welcoming. During breakfast, you welcome our guests, keep the buffet well stocked, clear tables and are available to assist with any questions or requests.

We are looking for someone who is an early riser and has no problem starting the day as early as 4:00 AM, always with a smile. You are responsible, passionate about service and enjoy creating a welcoming and pleasant atmosphere. You are flexible, efficient and communicate well with your colleagues. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are solution-oriented and can see what needs to be done without always having to be asked.

The role involves close collaboration with the kitchen and other departments, and during busy periods, we support each other wherever needed. We therefore value a humble attitude, team spirit and a genuine desire to contribute to an excellent guest experience.

Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Additional language skills are an advantage, as is previous experience in the restaurant, hotel or service industry.

The position is a fixed-term temporary employment starting in mid-December and ending at the end of February, with the possibility of an extension.

Staff accommodation is available. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and employment will be offered once we have found the right person for the position.

title: Servitris/Servitör Vintersäsong - Waitress/Waiter Winter Season
description:
Är du redo för en vintersäsong i norr?

På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet till större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter.

Som servitör/servitris hos oss arbetar du främst med à la carte-servering, där du ansvarar för att välkomna och ta hand om våra gäster genom hela restaurangbesöket. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat att ta beställningar, presentera mat och dryck, servera, följa upp gästens upplevelse samt hantera betalning och kassahantering. Du arbetar nära köket och dina kollegor för att skapa ett professionellt och personligt värdskap. Under perioder med högt tempo hjälps vi åt över avdelningsgränserna, vilket innebär att du även behöver vara beredd att stötta upp där det behövs.

Du som söker har en god känsla för service och värdskap, är prestigelös och flexibel och förstår vikten av att vara en lagspelare för att nå uppsatta mål. En vilja att lära kombinerat med en nyfikenhet och ett intresse för mat och dryck, allt för att gästen ska få med sig en känsla av att de fått något alldeles extra efter en vistelse hos oss.

Goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska är ett krav, övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande liksom tidigare erfarenhet av servering, bartending och kassahantering. Här kan tempot emellanåt vara högt och du behöver vara beredd att kunna rycka in där det behövs.

Personalboende finns att tillgå. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten.



Are you ready for a winter season in the north?

At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.

At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we offer breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the city's three cultures – Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian-Finnish – and these influences are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready to combine an exciting and challenging job with the spectacular mountain landscape, magical Northern Lights and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a waiter/waitress with us, you will primarily work with à la carte service, where you are responsible for welcoming and taking care of our guests throughout their entire dining experience. Your responsibilities include taking orders, presenting food and beverages, serving guests, following up on their experience, as well as handling payments and the cash register. You will work closely with the kitchen and your colleagues to create professional and personal hospitality. During busy periods, we support each other across departments, so you need to be willing to step in and help wherever needed.

We are looking for someone with a genuine passion for service and hospitality, who is humble, flexible and understands the importance of being a team player in achieving our goals. A willingness to learn, combined with curiosity and an interest in food and beverages, is important to ensure that our guests leave feeling they have experienced something truly special during their stay.

Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Additional language skills are an advantage, as is previous experience in restaurant service, bartending and cash handling. The pace can be high at times, and you need to be prepared to step in and help wherever needed.

Staff accommodation is available. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and employment will be offered once we have found the right person for the position.

title: Products & Solutions Development Manager
description:
Lead the Future of Energy – Process Engineering Manager Wanted

The world is in transition towards balanced energy, you can play an important part in crafting this future.

The D&S (Development & Standards) department is responsible for product development and maintenance of the auxiliary systems for the medium sized gas turbines. Thanks to our strong performance and positive momentum, we are growing and expanding our organization, bringing in additional managers to support our continued success.

We are looking for a manager for the process engineering group 1 responsible for the Air Intake, Acoustic enclosures, CFD, Gas/Fire Detection & Fire extinguishing systems.

A Snapshot of Your Day

In a typical day you will start the morning with an alignment meeting with your manager, Technical Area Managers and Lead Engineers to discuss about the outcome of yesterday’s work and the challenges of today. After this you will attend a gate or review team meeting related to product development of the new system design or work with planning of resources for upcoming projects and tasks

Just before lunch you attend a discussion on the strategy around next generation engineering system tools. Afterwards, you reflect together with your three closest manager colleagues on how you can collaborate to introduce the tools.

After a good lunch, you have a meeting with your team to follow up the progress and discuss group strategy. Next on schedule in your calendar is to attend a project pipeline meeting for a follow-up of the product development portfolio.

Just before you plan to end your job day, you see an email in your inbox, your application for specialist nomination for one of your employees has been approved. Tomorrow you will have good news to give her, but now it is time to head home.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Develop your team and your processes, create a world class working place and secure a successful future.

You will define and drive business strategies in alignment with your department's objectives and vision.

Contribute to the setup of the future process engineering department.

Support the system development of our engineering tools landscape ensuring we strive for our PLM vision.

Attendance in product-related gate and design reviews, ensuring high standards and compliance for your technical areas.

Conduct resource planning and allocation, making sure that the right competences are available and accessible for upcoming projects.

 

What You Bring

Strong leadership skills with significant experience in leading people and teams.

A positive attitude and a proactive, can-do mindset, combined with the ability to make decisions and drive things forward.

A strategic business approach and a good understanding of gas turbine technology and our products.

Excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across various functions and teams.

Strong drive and organizational skills, with the ability to see the complete picture.

Fluency in English, with a proven track record to act in an international environment. Swedish is beneficial.

 

About the Team

In this role, you will report to the Head of Process Engineering (PE). And be part of the D&S PE management team who enjoy working together and having fun at work.

Your department will consist of approx. 9 employees (plus temporary workers and colleagues in India

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 297729 not later than 2026-09-06

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Hotell- och konferenschef
description:
Wendelsbergs folkhögskola söker en hotell- och konferenschef som vill kombinera affärsmässighet med samhällsnytta. Tillträde under hösten 2026.

Hotell- och konferenschefen har ansvar för hotell, vandrarhem och konferensverksamhet. Det innefattar ledning av en personalgrupp på ca 10 personer, planering av verksamheten, försäljning, prissättning, marknadsföring och utveckling av både boende- och konferensverksamheten. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kökschef och även andra verksamheter på skolan.

Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildning och flera års erfarenhet av att driva och utveckla småskalig hotellverksamhet. Du har en naturlig känsla för värdskap och service och gillar kundkontakter. Du behöver känna en drivkraft i att utveckla verksamhet i en helnykter miljö och får gärna ha erfarenhet från idéburna organisationer. Vi ser gärna också att du har erfarenhet och intresse av digital marknadsföring. Ditt ledarskap präglas av tydlighet och god förmåga att fatta beslut kombinerat med en förmåga att lyssna. Administrativa uppgifter ingår i rollen, så ordning och reda är viktigt. Du kommer också att vara operativ i verksamheten och vid olika arrangemang hjälps vi alla åt. Schemalagt kvälls- och helgjobb ingår i tjänsten.

Wendelsberg – vi utbildar världsförbättrare och livsnjutare

Wendelsbergs folkhögskola är en av Movendi Sveriges (tidigare IOGT-NTO:s) två folkhögskolor och har erbjudit utbildningar i helnykter miljö sedan 1908. Wendelsberg är i första hand en skola men här finns dessutom flera andra viktiga verksamheter. Vi driver vandrarhem, hotell och viss restaurangverksamhet. Vandrarhemmet är anslutet till STF. Vi ger offentliga föreställningar i vår teater och erbjuder konferensmöjligheter i en unik miljö.

Wendelsberg har ett drygt 40-tal engagerade anställda och ett par hundra heltidsstuderande varav hälften bor på vårt internat. Hotellet/vandrarhemmet är helårsöppet med 28 rum. På sommaren ställer vi om internatboendet till vandrarhem och då tillkommer ytterligare ett 50-tal rum. Wendelsberg ligger i Mölnlycke – knappa 20 minuter från Göteborgs centrum.

Verksamheterna här är många och skiftande. På facebook, instagram, wendelsberg.se, wendelsberg.com och wendelsbergstetater.com kan du läsa mer och bättre förstå vad vi sysslar med.

Skolan har nära kontakt med huvudmannen vars värderingar genomsyrar verksamheten på Wendelsberg. Du kan läsa mer om huvudmannens verksamhet och framtida utveckling på www.iogt.se.

title: First Officer to M/S Eckerö Link
description:
Jobs on the Horizon - Welcome to Eckerö Link!

Eckerö Group has recently expanded its fleet with a new vessel, M/S Eckerö Link (formerly Nautica). The vessel is scheduled to enter service in September/October 2026.

We are currently seeking a First Officer to join us on M/S Eckerö Link. This is a permanent position starting immediately or as agreed.

M/S Eckerö Link sails under the Swedish flag and operates daily between Långnäs (Åland) and Naantali (Finland). The work rotation follows a 2:3 schedule.

The official working and safety language onboard is English, while skills in Finnish and Swedish are considered an advantage.

About the Role

The First Officer is responsible for safe navigation and watchkeeping, as well as supporting the safe and efficient operation of the vessel. Duties include monitoring safety and bridge equipment, assisting with deck and cargo operations, and following established safety procedures.

    Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
    A positive attitude and commitment to high safety and environmental standards

Requirements:

What We Offer

As a member of the Eckerö Link team, you will enjoy:

    Interesting and versatile duties in a dynamic and evolving company. We support learning, development, and career progression.
    A friendly, fair, and committed work community—both ashore in Mariehamn and onboard.
    Comprehensive occupational health care, as well as accident insurance covering both work and leisure time.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV by 17 September 2026

For security reasons, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the deadline.

Please note that drug testing is part of our recruitment process for all new employees.

For more information, please contact:

Gabriella Andersson, HR Specialist

gabriella.andersson@rederiabeckero.ax

Welcome aboard!

About Eckerö Group

Our ambition is to be the natural choice for both travel and transport across our destinations.

We aim to offer a pleasant, smart, and responsible way to travel and move goods — always going the extra mile to create a positive experience for our customers and passengers. Meeting one of us should feel like meeting a friend — we provide simple, reliable, and thoughtful solutions.

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n  
System Administrator Microsoft Workplace (80\-100%)  
Du hast deine Ausbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ (Fachrichtung Plattformentwicklung) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen und bereits erste Berufserfahrung im Betrieb von Windows\- und Microsoft\-Umgebungen gesammelt. Du weisst, dass ein stabiler Betrieb mehr ist als das Bearbeiten von Tickets. Es geht darum, Systeme und ihre Abhängigkeiten ganzheitlich zu verstehen, Auffälligkeiten durch proaktives Monitoring frühzeitig zu erkennen und Störungen mit einer strukturierten Ursachenanalyse nachhaltig zu beheben. Eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit steht dabei jederzeit im Zentrum. In unserem Team Smart Workplace übernimmst du Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb unserer Clients, Server, Microsoft\-365\-Umgebungen sowie unserer Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Plattform. Als zentrale technische Anlaufstelle priorisierst du Incidents nach Service Level und Business Impact und begleitest sie von der ersten Triage bis zur nachhaltigen Lösung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen System Engineers zusammen, die ihr Wissen aktiv weitergeben. Support, Betrieb und Engineering greifen bei uns eng ineinander. So kannst du technische Verantwortung übernehmen, deine Stärken gezielt einbringen und dich in einer zentralen Betriebsrolle fachlich weiterentwickeln. Wenn du Systeme nicht nur betreiben, sondern wirklich verstehen möchtest, passt du gut zu uns.  
Was dich erwartet  
Betrieb und Pflege von Clients und Servern im Microsoft 365 und Windows Umfeld  
Konfiguration, Wartung und Lifecycle von Clients, Servern und Citrix Komponenten  
Analyse und Lösung technischer Störungen, remote und vor Ort  
Bearbeitung von Service Requests und Changes nach klaren, strukturierten Abläufen  
Verantwortung für das Inventar von Hardware und Software sowie für saubere Dokumentation  
Mitarbeit in Projekten rund um Workplace, Cloud und Infrastruktur  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Engineers, Network und Security  
Wir wünschen uns von dir  
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ, ICT Fachperson EFZ oder vergleichbare Qualifikation  
Solide Praxis im Umfeld von Microsoft 365 sowie Windows Clients und Servern/li\>  
Erste Berührungspunkte mit Citrix. Tiefe baust du bei uns auf  
Verständnis für ITIL Prozesse, kein Zertifikatsfetisch, sondern strukturiertes Arbeiten  
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und echte Neugier, Dinge zu verstehen, statt nur zu beheben

Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

Un environnement de travail engagé  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.

Cloud Security

Data Security & Compliance

- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.

title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.

•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.

German and English \- both C1\+

Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.  
Meta \& Creatives. Du planst, launchst und optimierst unsere Meta\-Kampagnen. Du treibst die Creatives, die sie füttern – Static und Video – von Inhouse\-Produktion bis zum Briefen und Steuern von Agenturen. Du weisst: Eine Gewinner\-Ad ist kein Glückstreffer, sondern eine Testing\-Pipeline.  
Funnels. Du baust Marketing\-Funnels entlang der gesamten Customer Journey und optimierst sie konsequent – vom ersten Klick bis zum Wiederkauf.  
Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.  
Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.  
Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop\-Experience zu verbessern, E\-Commerce\-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.  
Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing\- und Sales\-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.  
Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten

description:

Spa \& Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)  
ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung  
Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Die Reinigung und der Unterhalt der Spa Anlagen (Innen und Aussenbereich)  
Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs\- und Fitnessräume  
Betreuen der SPA\-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich  
Auffüllen von Verbrauchmaterialien sowie allgemeine Aufräumarbeiten im Spa  
Ihr Profil:  
Erfahrungen im Housekeeping oder in der Spa Reinigung setzten wir voraus  
körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.)  
gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten  
Sie sprechen Deutsch oder Englisch  
Freude im Umgaben mit den Spa Gästen und im Team zu arbeiten  
Bereitschaft für Schicht\- und Wochenendarbeit  
Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.  
Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.  
Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.  
Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.  
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.
